description: Create a synthetic on-chain payment for an invoice (inv_) or credit purchase (cpu_) and run it through the real state machine and webhook pipeline. Test keys only. confirmations=0 -> payment.detected / invoice.pending; confirmations >= required -> invoice.paid. Use a smaller/larger amount to simulate underpaid/overpaid. Reuse tx_hash to advance the same payment.

amount.description: Amount in the asset; defaults to the exact payment_options[].amount.

asset.description: Which payment option to pay; defaults to the first accepted asset.

name: simulate_test_payment
title: Simulate a payment (test mode)
